newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HSBC Investment Bank Asia opens Bangkok office.
newsitem.headline: HSBC Investment Bank Asia opens Bangkok office.

text.p: HSBC Investment Bank Asia Ltd, the HSBC Group Plc's investment banking arm in Asia, said on Tuesday it had opened a representative office in Bangkok.

The office would provide corporate finance and equity capital markets services to local companies raising funds in overseas markets, as well as liaise with foreign investors seeking investments in Thailand, it said.
The Bankok office's representatives are Christopher Weir and Pongsakorn Thiengtham, it said.
